    About

    I am a third year Ph.D. student at Northeastern University working with Lu Wang. My research focuses are natural language inference, argumentative text understanding and generation. My CV can be downloaded here.

    I received my B.Eng. in Computer Science from Shanghai Jiao Tong University, where I was a member of ADAPT lab directed by Kenny Q. Zhu.

    Currently I’m a summer research intern at IBM Research AI, working with Avi Sil on question answering and language inference.
